principles.rule: All TypeScript imports must use .js extension (ESM requirement), even when importing .ts source files
API keys and secrets must NEVER be passed to containers directly. All AI/external API calls from containers must route through the credential proxy (port 3001 / unix socket)
All database access must go through src/db.ts exported functions. No raw SQL or direct better-sqlite3 calls in other modules.
src/config.ts may only export non-secret configuration values read from env. Secrets belong exclusively in credential-proxy.ts.
Channels must use the self-registration pattern: call registerChannel(name, factory) at module load. Factory returns null when credentials are missing.
All container mount paths must be validated against the mount allowlist (mount-security.ts) before spawning containers. Never bypass mount security.
Never use bare catch blocks or catch(e: any). Always type or narrow errors. Use the eslint-plugin-no-catch-all rules.
Always use structured logging: logger.info({ key: value }, 'message'). Never use console.log in src/.
Test files must be colocated with source files (foo.test.ts next to foo.ts). No separate test directory.
Do not add abstractions, helpers, or utilities for one-time operations. Minimum complexity for current task. Three similar lines is better than a premature abstraction.
Prefer editing existing files over creating new ones. Only create new files when clearly necessary (new channel, new module).
Only groups with isMain: true have unrestricted trigger access and can execute privileged operations (register groups, schedule tasks, remote control).
